use_case_summary: PivotBeam is a mid-market product analytics platform that wants to power fuzzy product search, content recommendations, and in-app support using vector embeddings. Key requirements: sub-60ms search latencies for interactive UI, scalable nightly batch embedding for 30M docs within a 2-3 hour window, tight cost controls for embeddings, and enterprise-grade security (SSO, audit logs, KMS). They want to prototype on Redwood Hosted API to validate model quality and integration with their vector store, then move to Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput and cost. Also interested in recommendations from Redwood Optimize for batching/quantization to lower unit cost.
technical_requirements: Query throughput target: 200 qps sustained for semantic search API
95th percentile latency target: < 60ms for search responses
Batch embedding throughput: >= 150k docs/hour during nightly window
Support for OR/AND filters + metadata faceting in search results
Integrations: Pinecone connector OR Postgres+pgvector; prefer minimal code rewrite
Data residency: US only (can use US-East multi-AZ)
Logging/audit: token-level request logs + retention 13 months
poc_details: Three-phase POC agreed: Phase A hosted API (2 weeks) — validate embedding quality + FE latency; Phase B dedicated baseline (1 week) — run sustained queries against 2xGPU pool to measure tail latency and autoscaling behavior; Phase C batch ingest (1 week) — ingest 1M sample docs, run cost and retry/failure scenarios. Success metrics: query latency SLOs met, batch job completes within target window, and cost per 1M embeddings within threshold. Deliverables: baseline report, tuning recommendations, draft reserved capacity proposal.
pricing_discussion: Discussed two pricing levers: pay-as-you-go hosted tokens/embeds vs reserved Dedicated capacity. PivotBeam favors a hybrid: host UI traffic on Hosted for early rollout (lower time-to-value) then shift heavy embedding batch jobs to Dedicated reserved capacity for predictable ARR. Finance asks: committed monthly spend range and breakpoints for discounts. SE provided model of expected spend at 5M embeddings/month and scenarios with 10-30% reserved discounts.
